name: Itou Hitomi
source:
The wife of the protagonist's relative. She is an intelligent beauty with a motherly side. She appears calm, but gets aroused easily and is disappointed whenever sex is over.

Her husband lacks sexual knowledge and has no idea how to please a woman.
